design\releases\0_1_0\card__f9a450d8-0f93-4487-99f3-23dcc07b42b2.json:49:          "content": "---\nauthor: \nid: F_138\ntitle: reduce action popup rerenders during streaming\nstatus: design\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\n  - design/activity/card__f9a450d8-0f93-4487-99f3-23dcc07b42b2.json#conversation=agent-0b2e6bc1-6d29-4234-82e8-9570c342bd93\npolicy:\ninternalId: f9a450d8-0f93-4487-99f3-23dcc07b42b2\nafter: \nworktree: 1\n---\n\n## Problem\n\nWhile an agent is producing a response, short text updates (streaming deltas) arrive very frequently. Each delta currently causes far more rendering work in the action popup than necessary. The deltas themselves are wanted (text should appear as soon as possible); the problem is how much re-renders per delta.\n\n## Investigation results (current behavior)\n\nThe popup shell (`app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx`) does **not** re-render on deltas: it holds no run subscription, subscriptions live in small \"owner\" components. The run registry (`app/src/services/actions/action_run_registry.ts`) publishes immutably: each delta produces a new `run`, new `conversation`, and new `entries` array, but **all entry objects except the one currently being streamed keep stable references** (see `appendAssistantMessage`, which only replaces the updated entry via `entries.map`). This stability is the property the fix relies on.\n\nTwo actual problems:\n\n1. **The whole transcript re-parses markdown on every delta.** `ActionConversationChat` (`app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx`, entries map around lines 91-121) renders all entries inline. Each delta therefore runs `ReactMarkdown` (full markdown parse + AST render) for every historical balloon, not just the live one. Cost is the dominant one and grows linearly with conversation length.\n\n2. **Four components subscribe to the whole `run` object** via `useActionRun`, so they re-render on every delta even though they do not need streaming text:\n   - `ActionConversationPickerOwner`\n   - `ActionAgentSelectorsOwner`\n   - `ActionPhraseButtonsOwner`\n   - `ActionAgentPromptOwner` (worst: the prompt editor re-renders per delta)\n\n   Selector-based subscribers (`status`, `question`, `approvals`, the bottom row) already bail out via `Object.is` in `useSyncExternalStore` and are fine.\n\n## Requested changes\n\n1. **Memoize per-entry rendering.** Extract the message balloon and the event row from `ActionConversationChat` into small components wrapped in `React.memo`, keyed as today (`entry.id` for messages, `eventIdentity(entry)` for events). Because completed entries are referentially stable, only the streaming balloon re-parses markdown; everything else becomes a skipped render plus a trivial DOM diff. Scroll growth keeps working because the list container itself still re-renders (cheaply) and the existing `useLayoutEffect` stick-to-end logic stays intact.\n\n2. **Narrow the four `useActionRun` users** listed above to `useActionRunSelector` calls that return primitives or stable slices, so they stop re-rendering per delta. While doing so, verify `selectErrorLogs` in `action_log_error_owner.tsx` returns a stable reference (if it filters/maps per call it also re-renders every delta and needs the same treatment).\n\n3. **Optional, low priority:** memoize `visibleConversationEntries` / `hasAgentActivity` in `ActionConversationChat` (currently an O(n) scan over all entries per delta).\n\n## Explicitly out of scope\n\n- **Virtualizing the conversation list.** Entries have text-dependent variable heights, and after change 1 the per-delta work is one balloon re-parse plus browser layout. Virtualization would only matter for conversations with thousands of entries; not worth the complexity now.\n- Changing the streaming update frequency or batching deltas â€” short updates should keep arriving as fast as they do today.\n\n## Verification\n\nWith React DevTools profiler (\"highlight updates\") during a streaming run:\n- before: the entire transcript flashes on every delta;\n- after: only the last (streaming) balloon and the status row update; the prompt editor, phrase buttons, selectors, and conversation picker do not re-render per delta.\n\r\n",

design\releases\0_1_0\card__f9a450d8-0f93-4487-99f3-23dcc07b42b2.json:324:          "content": "---\ninternalId: f2ec9e28-8064-4707-bce9-b62f24d57524\n---\n\n# App Style Guide â€” Kanban / MDÂ² (React + MUI)\n\nHow to build **any new component** so it matches the app. This is written for **Material UI v5+** components.\n\n**The theme is the source of truth.** All color, radius, base typography, and spacing units live in the single `createTheme` (defined in `GUIDANCE.md` Â§1/Â§9). This guide does **not** define colors â€” it tells you **which theme value to use for which role**, and covers the things the theme can't encode: layout, spacing/margins, borders, elevation, and component conventions.\n\n**The one rule that matters:** never write a raw hex, px radius, or magic color into a component. Read it from the theme (`theme.palette.*`, `theme.shape`, `theme.typography`, `theme.spacing`). If a component has a hardcoded hex in its `sx`/styled, it's wrong â€” that's exactly where the look drifts and where dark mode breaks.\n\n---\n\n## 1. How to consume the theme\n\n- **Colors:** `sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', bgcolor: 'background.paper', borderColor: 'divider' }}` â€” MUI resolves dotted palette paths automatically in `sx`. In `styled`/JS use the callback form: `styled(Box)(({ theme }) => ({ color: theme.palette.text.secondary }))`.\n- **Spacing:** use the 8px unit via the spacing scale â€” `sx={{ p: 2, gap: 1, mt: 1.5 }}` (`2` = 16px, `1` = 8px). Don't write `padding: '16px'`.\n- **Radius:** `borderRadius: 1` (= `theme.shape.borderRadius` = 8) and multiples; for the fixed non-8 radii see Â§4.\n- **Typography:** prefer `Typography variant=...` and `theme.typography.*` over ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n- **Custom tokens:** roles the default MUI palette doesn't cover (column/track surfaces, the strong/hover border steps, `text-3/4`, section-header color, `primary-bg` tint, status colors) must exist in the theme under a namespace (e.g. `theme.palette.custom.*`) with light + dark values. Consume them the same way â€” `bgcolor: 'custom.column'`. **Never inline their hex.** If a needed token doesn't exist yet, add it to the theme, don't hardcode it in the component.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Role â†’ theme slot\n\nPick the slot by the element's **role**, not by how it looks in one mode:\n\n| Role | Theme slot |\n|---|---|\n| App background; tinted footer/action bars | `background.default` |\n| Column & sidebar surface | `custom.column` |\n| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |\n| Card, dialog, popup, input surface | `background.paper` |\n| Hairlines, resting borders | `divider` |\n| Input borders, vertical separators | `custom.borderStrong` |\n| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |\n| Titles, values, headings | `text.primary` |\n| Body copy, field labels | `text.secondary` |\n| Meta, captions, resting icons | `custom.text3` |\n| Muted / placeholder / disabled | `custom.text4` |\n| Uppercase section/column headers | `custom.colHead` |\n| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |\n| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |\n| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |\n| Text/icon on a primary fill | `primary.contrastText` |\n| Active / saved / online dot | `success.main` |\n| Destructive action | `error.main` |\n| Status swatch dots & ID-chip tints (decorative only) | `custom.status.*` |\n\nRules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) â€” everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Layout\n\n- **Full-height app:** column flex â€” menu row / ribbon / content (`flex: 1; minHeight: 0`) / status bar. Fixed bands `flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Board:** horizontal-scroll flex row, `gap: 2` (16px), page padding `p: 2.5` (20px); columns `width: 296, flexShrink: 0`, internal column flex `gap: 1`.\n- **List view:** two-pane flex row filling the space between ribbon and status bar â€” sidebar `width: 280, flexShrink: 0`, editor pane `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` (the `minWidth: 0` is required so long content ellipsizes instead of blowing out the row).\n- **Panels (sidebar, editor card, dialogs):** column flex with stacked bands (header / [toolbar] / body / footer). The **body scrolls** (`overflow-y: auto; minHeight: 0`); header and footer are `flexShrink: 0` and never scroll away.\n- **Spacer pattern:** push trailing items with `<Box sx={{ flex: 1 }} />` rather than `margin-left: auto` sprinkled around, so rows stay predictable.\n- Use flex `gap` for spacing between siblings â€” don't hand-space with per-child margins.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Spacing, margin & size conventions\n\n- **4/8px grid, via `theme.spacing`.** page padding `2.5`; between columns `2`; inside columns / between related controls `1`; dialog body gap `2â€“2.25`; field labelâ†’control gap `~0.9` (7px).\n- **Margins:** prefer padding on containers + flex `gap` over element margins. Where a floating panel needs breathing room (e.g. editor card, toolbar inside a panel), use container padding (`p: 2 / 2.5`), not margins on the children.\n- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26â€“28, input 42.\n- **Fixed widths (px):** column 296, sidebar 280, search 260, standard dialog 480, wide/editor dialog 760.\n- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6â€“7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Borders & elevation\n\n- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).\n- **Separation between bands:** a single 1px `divider` hairline. Don't stack a heavy rule *and* an outline â€” one line, let background contrast do the rest. Vertical separators inside toolbars: a 20px-tall `custom.borderStrong` rule.\n- **Elevation ladder (only where floating):** card hover `0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)`; dragging MUI `elevation 8` + `rotate(2deg)`; contained button `0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.15)`; dialog/popup `0 24px 60px rgba(16,24,40,0.28)`; scrim `rgba(16,24,40,0.45)` + `backdropFilter: blur(2px)`.\n- Set `MuiPaper.elevation: 0` and `MuiButton.disableElevation` globally in the theme; add the shadows above explicitly where the ladder calls for it.\n- **On dark backgrounds shadows read as nothing** â€” the theme already handles this by making hover raise `borderColor` (`custom.borderHover`) instead of relying on shadow.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Typography usage\n\nDrive everything from theme variants / `theme.typography`; avoid ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n\n- Titles/values/headings â†’ `text.primary`; body & labels â†’ `text.secondary`; meta â†’ `custom.text3`.\n- **Field labels:** a plain `Typography` (12px/600, `text.secondary`) placed **above** the control â€” **never** MUI floating/outlined `TextField` labels (they clash with the app's flat-label style).\n- **Section/column headers:** `Typography variant=\"overline\"` (uppercase, `letterSpacing ~0.7px`, `fontWeight 700`, `custom.colHead`).\n- **ID chips only** use monospace; everything else is the theme's default family.\n- `button.textTransform: 'none'` and `button.fontWeight: 600` are set in the theme â€” don't re-uppercase buttons.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Interaction states\n\nConsistent across all components; all colors from the theme:\n\n- **Ghost icon button** (`IconButton`): transparent â†’ hover `bgcolor: track` (or `background.paper` on a colored panel) + `color: primary.main`. Override MUI's default circular hover tint via `sx`.\n- **Outlined button:** `divider` border, `text.secondary` â†’ hover `borderColor/color: primary.main`. Destructive: hover `borderColor: error.main` + `bgcolor: custom.dangerBg`.\n- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow â†’ hover `primary.dark`.\n- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.\n- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.\n- **Row-level actions** (delete, â‹®): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).\n- **Active tab/menu item:** 2px `primary.main` bottom border + `primary.main` text.\n- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Component conventions (MUI primitives)\n\n- **Buttons:** `Button variant=\"contained\"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant=\"outlined\"` = secondary; `variant=\"text\"` = tertiary. Icon-only â†’ `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).\n- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13â€“15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.\n- **ID chip:** monospace, accent text on `custom.primaryBg`/status tint, `radius 5, flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Count chip:** `background.paper` bg, 1px `divider`, radius 9â€“10, `custom.text3`.\n- **State dot:** 7â€“8px circle + `text-3` label; green (`success.main`) = active/saved/online.\n- **Search:** pill `TextField` (`borderRadius: 99`, `bgcolor: background.default`), search start-adornment, `âŒ˜K` keycap end-adornment.\n- **Select:** `size=\"small\"`, optional dot+name via `renderValue`; 42px / radius-9 frame. When a select has a tooltip, keep the tooltip available while the select is closed and explicitly hide it for the entire time the select menu is open so it cannot cover the first option.\n- **Segmented control** (view switch, formatting toolbar): `ToggleButtonGroup` on a `custom.track` background; selected segment `background.paper` + `0 1px 2px` shadow + `primary` text.\n- **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` â†’ `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`âŒ˜/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop.\n- **Empty state:** dashed target â€” `1.5px dashed custom.borderStrong`, radius 10, centered icon + `custom.text4` label. No \"click to add\" placeholder blocks.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Definition of done for a new component\n\n1. Zero hardcoded hex / raw px colors â€” every value comes from `theme.palette` / `theme.shape` / `theme.spacing` / `theme.typography`.\n2. Correct roleâ†’slot mapping (Â§2); at most one `primary` CTA on the surface.\n3. Borders at rest, shadow only when floating (Â§5); bands split by a single hairline.\n4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (Â§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.\n5. Body scrolls, header/footer pinned; `minWidth: 0` on flex children that hold long text.\n6. Toggle to dark mode and confirm nothing breaks â€” if it does, you hardcoded a color somewhere (Â§1).\n\nComponent-specific detail lives in `GUIDANCE.md` (theme definition + board/list/dialog), `CARD_POPUP_GUIDE.md`, `RUN_DIALOG_GUIDE.md`, and `SIDEBAR_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md`.\n\r\n",

Where a floating panel needs breathing room (e.g. editor card, toolbar inside a panel), use container padding (`p: 2 / 2.5`), not margins on the children.\n- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26â€“28, input 42.\n- **Fixed widths (px):** column 296, sidebar 280, search 260, standard dialog 480, wide/editor dialog 760.\n- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6â€“7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Borders & elevation\n\n- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).\n- **Separation between bands:** a single 1px `divider` hairline. Don't stack a heavy rule *and* an outline â€” one line, let background contrast do the rest. Vertical separators inside toolbars: a 20px-tall `custom.borderStrong` rule.\n- **Elevation ladder (only where floating):** card hover `0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)`; dragging MUI `elevation 8` + `rotate(2deg)`; contained button `0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.15)`; dialog/popup `0 24px 60px rgba(16,24,40,0.28)`; scrim `rgba(16,24,40,0.45)` + `backdropFilter: blur(2px)`.\n- Set `MuiPaper.elevation: 0` and `MuiButton.disableElevation` globally in the theme; add the shadows above explicitly where the ladder calls for it.\n- **On dark backgrounds shadows read as nothing** â€” the theme already handles this by making hover raise `borderColor` (`custom.borderHover`) instead of relying on shadow.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Typography usage\n\nDrive everything from theme variants / `theme.typography`; avoid ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n\n- Titles/values/headings â†’ `text.primary`; body & labels â†’ `text.secondary`; meta â†’ `custom.text3`.\n- **Field labels:** a plain `Typography` (12px/600, `text.secondary`) placed **above** the control â€” **never** MUI floating/outlined `TextField` labels (they clash with the app's flat-label style).\n- **Section/column headers:** `Typography variant=\"overline\"` (uppercase, `letterSpacing ~0.7px`, `fontWeight 700`, `custom.colHead`).\n- **ID chips only** use monospace; everything else is the theme's default family.\n- `button.textTransform: 'none'` and `button.fontWeight: 600` are set in the theme â€” don't re-uppercase buttons.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Interaction states\n\nConsistent across all components; all colors from the theme:\n\n- **Ghost icon button** (`IconButton`): transparent â†’ hover `bgcolor: track` (or `background.paper` on a colored panel) + `color: primary.main`. Override MUI's default circular hover tint via `sx`.\n- **Outlined button:** `divider` border, `text.secondary` â†’ hover `borderColor/color: primary.main`. Destructive: hover `borderColor: error.main` + `bgcolor: custom.dangerBg`.\n- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow â†’ hover `primary.dark`.\n- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.\n- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.\n- **Row-level actions** (delete, â‹®): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).\n- **Active tab/menu item:** 2px `primary.main` bottom border + `primary.main` text.\n- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Component conventions (MUI primitives)\n\n- **Buttons:** `Button variant=\"contained\"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant=\"outlined\"` = secondary; `variant=\"text\"` = tertiary. Icon-only â†’ `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).\n- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13â€“15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.\n- **ID chip:** monospace, accent text on `custom.primaryBg`/status tint, `radius 5, flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Count chip:** `background.paper` bg, 1px `divider`, radius 9â€“10, `custom.text3`.\n- **State dot:** 7â€“8px circle + `text-3` label; green (`success.main`) = active/saved/online.\n- **Search:** pill `TextField` (`borderRadius: 99`, `bgcolor: background.default`), search start-adornment, `âŒ˜K` keycap end-adornment.\n- **Select:** `size=\"small\"`, optional dot+name via `renderValue`; 42px / radius-9 frame. When a select has a tooltip, keep the tooltip available while the select is closed and explicitly hide it for the entire time the select menu is open so it cannot cover the first option.\n- **Segmented control** (view switch, formatting toolbar): `ToggleButtonGroup` on a `custom.track` background; selected segment `background.paper` + `0 1px 2px` shadow + `primary` text.\n- **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` â†’ `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`âŒ˜/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop.\n- **Empty state:** dashed target â€” `1.5px dashed custom.borderStrong`, radius 10, centered icon + `custom.text4` label. No \"click to add\" placeholder blocks.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Definition of done for a new component\n\n1. Zero hardcoded hex / raw px colors â€” every value comes from `theme.palette` / `theme.shape` / `theme.spacing` / `theme.typography`.\n2. Correct roleâ†’slot mapping (Â§2); at most one `primary` CTA on the surface.\n3. Borders at rest, shadow only when floating (Â§5); bands split by a single hairline.\n4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (Â§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.\n5. Body scrolls, header/footer pinned; `minWidth: 0` on flex children that hold long text.\n6. Toggle to dark mode and confirm nothing breaks â€” if it does, you hardcoded a color somewhere (Â§1).\n\nComponent-specific detail lives in `GUIDANCE.md` (theme definition + board/list/dialog), `CARD_POPUP_GUIDE.md`, `RUN_DIALOG_GUIDE.md`, and `SIDEBAR_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md`.\n\r\n",

As the user types characters after the @, the search list should be further refined.\n\nif the user clicks on a filename or presses enter, the filename should be selected and inserted in the markdown editor as a file link.\n\nI believe there is already some work done for this, like getting all the filenames in the project. please check code base for stuff we can re-use\n\n## Current state\n\n`MarkdownEditor` already installs a Lexical typeahead plugin for `{{` placeholders. It owns trigger matching, filtering, keyboard/mouse selection, MUI popup rendering and text replacement. No `@` file-search plugin exists.\n\nProject loading already stores every repository-relative file path in `ProjectSnapshot.repositoryFiles` for local Git, GitHub and remote-control storage. `useProjectState` exposes this list to React components; no new storage or desktop API is needed.\n\n## Implementation details\n\n- Add a separate file-search realm/typeahead plugin beside the placeholder plugin and install it in every `MarkdownEditor`, including toolbarless editors and new-card/action-prompt surfaces.\n- Read options from current `ProjectSnapshot.repositoryFiles` and update them when project state changes. With no open project or no files, `@` remains normal text and no popup opens.\n- Trigger on `@`, filter repository-relative paths case-insensitively as characters are typed, and show enough path context to distinguish duplicate filenames.\n- Mouse selection or Enter replaces the trigger/query with `[filename](repository-relative/path)`. Keep destination repository-relative; do not rewrite it relative to current document.\n- Keep placeholder behavior unchanged. Use separate trigger, option and popup components so file-search logic does not alter placeholder types or formatting.\n- Tests cover trigger boundaries, filtering, duplicate names, keyboard/mouse selection, link insertion, empty project state and coexistence with `{{` placeholders across editor presentations.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- Typing `@` in any editable Markdown editor opens a project-file popup when repository files exist.\n- Further typing filters paths case-insensitively; duplicate filenames remain distinguishable.\n- Clicking a result or pressing Enter inserts `[filename](repository-relative/path)` at the query location.\n- Arrow-key navigation, dismissal and mouse selection work without losing editor focus.\n- Empty/unloaded projects leave typed `@` text unchanged and show no empty popup.\n- Existing placeholder typeahead, Markdown editing and persistence behavior remain unchanged.\n\r\n",

design\releases\0_1_0\card__5cdae748-9597-4d29-8dc0-3d4b5df3aa7f.json:136:          "content": "---\ninternalId: f2ec9e28-8064-4707-bce9-b62f24d57524\n---\n\n# App Style Guide â€” Kanban / MDÂ² (React + MUI)\n\nHow to build **any new component** so it matches the app. This is written for **Material UI v5+** components.\n\n**The theme is the source of truth.** All color, radius, base typography, and spacing units live in the single `createTheme` (defined in `GUIDANCE.md` Â§1/Â§9). This guide does **not** define colors â€” it tells you **which theme value to use for which role**, and covers the things the theme can't encode: layout, spacing/margins, borders, elevation, and component conventions.\n\n**The one rule that matters:** never write a raw hex, px radius, or magic color into a component. Read it from the theme (`theme.palette.*`, `theme.shape`, `theme.typography`, `theme.spacing`). If a component has a hardcoded hex in its `sx`/styled, it's wrong â€” that's exactly where the look drifts and where dark mode breaks.\n\n---\n\n## 1. How to consume the theme\n\n- **Colors:** `sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', bgcolor: 'background.paper', borderColor: 'divider' }}` â€” MUI resolves dotted palette paths automatically in `sx`. In `styled`/JS use the callback form: `styled(Box)(({ theme }) => ({ color: theme.palette.text.secondary }))`.\n- **Spacing:** use the 8px unit via the spacing scale â€” `sx={{ p: 2, gap: 1, mt: 1.5 }}` (`2` = 16px, `1` = 8px). Don't write `padding: '16px'`.\n- **Radius:** `borderRadius: 1` (= `theme.shape.borderRadius` = 8) and multiples; for the fixed non-8 radii see Â§4.\n- **Typography:** prefer `Typography variant=...` and `theme.typography.*` over ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n- **Custom tokens:** roles the default MUI palette doesn't cover (column/track surfaces, the strong/hover border steps, `text-3/4`, section-header color, `primary-bg` tint, status colors) must exist in the theme under a namespace (e.g. `theme.palette.custom.*`) with light + dark values. Consume them the same way â€” `bgcolor: 'custom.column'`. **Never inline their hex.** If a needed token doesn't exist yet, add it to the theme, don't hardcode it in the component.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Role â†’ theme slot\n\nPick the slot by the element's **role**, not by how it looks in one mode:\n\n| Role | Theme slot |\n|---|---|\n| App background; tinted footer/action bars | `background.default` |\n| Column & sidebar surface | `custom.column` |\n| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |\n| Card, dialog, popup, input surface | `background.paper` |\n| Hairlines, resting borders | `divider` |\n| Input borders, vertical separators | `custom.borderStrong` |\n| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |\n| Titles, values, headings | `text.primary` |\n| Body copy, field labels | `text.secondary` |\n| Meta, captions, resting icons | `custom.text3` |\n| Muted / placeholder / disabled | `custom.text4` |\n| Uppercase section/column headers | `custom.colHead` |\n| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |\n| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |\n| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |\n| Text/icon on a primary fill | `primary.contrastText` |\n| Active / saved / online dot | `success.main` |\n| Destructive action | `error.main` |\n| Status swatch dots & ID-chip tints (decorative only) | `custom.status.*` |\n\nRules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) â€” everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Layout\n\n- **Full-height app:** column flex â€” menu row / ribbon / content (`flex: 1; minHeight: 0`) / status bar. Fixed bands `flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Board:** horizontal-scroll flex row, `gap: 2` (16px), page padding `p: 2.5` (20px); columns `width: 296, flexShrink: 0`, internal column flex `gap: 1`.\n- **List view:** two-pane flex row filling the space between ribbon and status bar â€” sidebar `width: 280, flexShrink: 0`, editor pane `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` (the `minWidth: 0` is required so long content ellipsizes instead of blowing out the row).\n- **Panels (sidebar, editor card, dialogs):** column flex with stacked bands (header / [toolbar] / body / footer). The **body scrolls** (`overflow-y: auto; minHeight: 0`); header and footer are `flexShrink: 0` and never scroll away.\n- **Spacer pattern:** push trailing items with `<Box sx={{ flex: 1 }} />` rather than `margin-left: auto` sprinkled around, so rows stay predictable.\n- Use flex `gap` for spacing between siblings â€” don't hand-space with per-child margins.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Spacing, margin & size conventions\n\n- **4/8px grid, via `theme.spacing`.** page padding `2.5`; between columns `2`; inside columns / between related controls `1`; dialog body gap `2â€“2.25`; field labelâ†’control gap `~0.9` (7px).\n- **Margins:** prefer padding on containers + flex `gap` over element margins. Where a floating panel needs breathing room (e.g. editor card, toolbar inside a panel), use container padding (`p: 2 / 2.5`), not margins on the children.\n- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26â€“28, input 42.\n- **Fixed widths (px):** column 296, sidebar 280, search 260, standard dialog 480, wide/editor dialog 760.\n- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6â€“7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Borders & elevation\n\n- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).\n- **Separation between bands:** a single 1px `divider` hairline. >\n                <List aria-label=\"Available placeholders\" dense disablePadding role=\"listbox\">\n                    {itemProps.options.map((option, index) => (\n                      onSelect={itemProps.selectOptionAndCleanUp}\n                            placeholder={option.placeholder}\n                            selectionOption={option}\n                            selected={itemProps.selectedIndex === index}\n                            setRefElement={option.setRefElement}\n                        />\n                    ))}\n                </List>\n            </Paper>,\n            anchorElementRef.current,\n        )\n    }, [])\n\n    return (\n        <LexicalTypeaheadMenuPlugin<MarkdownPlaceholderOption>\n            menuRenderFn={renderMenu}\n            onQueryChange={handleQueryChange}\n            onSelectOption={handleSelectOption}\n            options={options}\n            parent={overlayContainer ?? editorRef.current?.insertMarkdown(markdown)\n    }, [])\n\n    const defaultToolbarContents = useCallback(\n        () => <MarkdownFormatToolbarControls overlayContainer={overlayContainer} historyPluginConfig ? markdownDocumentHistoryPlugin(historyPluginConfig) : null\n    const plugins = [\n        headingsPlugin(),\n        listsPlugin(),\n        quotePlugin(),\n        thematicBreakPlugin(),\n        linkPlugin(),\n        linkDialogPlugin(),\n        imagePlugin(),\n        tablePlugin(),\n        codeBlockPlugin({ defaultCodeBlockLanguage: DEFAULT_CODE_LANGUAGE The card popup can show diffs for historical commits recorded in card activity, but it does not include the current worktree changes that are waiting to be integrated.\n\n## Required behavior\n\nAdd **View diff** to the same worktree menu as **Integrate into project**.\n\nThe new action must have exactly the same availability as **Integrate into project**. It is available only when the card has a valid assigned worktree with outgoing changes. If integration is unavailable, viewing the worktree diff is also unavailable.\n\nSelecting **View diff** shows the net changes the assigned card worktree would bring into the project branch. The diff covers the complete worktree change set, not only the card Markdown file or one agent commit. Use the card's existing diff-viewing experience, including the card body diff and navigation to other changed files.\n\nThe card popup's existing diff selector must also contain this worktree diff:\n\n- Show it as the first entry, above the historical commit diffs.\n- Label it clearly as the current worktree changes; do not present it as a commit.\n- Selecting it opens the same worktree diff as **View diff** in the worktree menu.\n- Keep the existing historical commit ordering and behavior unchanged.\n- Remove the entry as soon as **Integrate into project** is no longer available, including after successful integration.\n\nThe worktree diff is current repository state. Do not persist it in card activity and do not create a synthetic commit or activity record for it.\n\n## Implementation constraints\n\nThe current diff contract is commit-based and runs the configured commit diff command. Add a separate read-only worktree-diff operation rather than putting placeholder commit data into `CardCommit` or `ActivityCommitReference`.\n\nResolve the worktree through `WorktreeService` from the card's assigned worktree. The backend remains responsible for Git access and returns normalized per-file diff data to the renderer. Reading the diff must not commit, stage, rebase, merge, or otherwise change either worktree.\n\nModel the card popup selection as either a current worktree diff or a historical commit diff. Both entry points must use the same worktree-diff loading and presentation path. Derive availability from the same worktree status condition used by **Integrate into project** so the two controls cannot disagree.\n\nErrors while loading the diff must be reported through `dialogService` and leave the card popup in a safe state. An invalid or removed worktree must not fall back to the primary project folder.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- A card with an integratable assigned worktree shows **View diff** beside the existing worktree actions.\n- **View diff** is enabled if and only if **Integrate into project** is enabled.\n- The displayed diff is the complete net worktree change set that integration would apply to the project branch.\n- Added, modified, deleted, and renamed files that belong to that change set are represented correctly.\n- The card popup diff selector shows **Current worktree changes** as its first entry while integration is possible.\n- Selecting the menu action or the card popup entry opens the same diff.\n- Historical commit diffs remain below the new entry and retain their existing order and behavior.\n- The current worktree entry disappears after successful integration or whenever the worktree is no longer integratable.\n- Viewing the diff does not mutate Git state or write card activity.\n- Missing worktrees and Git failures are reported without showing a diff from another repository folder.\n\n## Tests\n\nAdd coverage for:\n\n1. Worktree diff generation across the project branch and assigned worktree.\n2. Added, modified, deleted, and renamed files in the returned diff.\n3. No Git mutation while reading a worktree diff.\n4. Matching availability of **View diff** and **Integrate into project**.\n5. The current worktree entry appearing first in the card popup diff selector.\n6. Both entry points selecting the same worktree diff.\n7. Removal of the entry after integration or loss of worktree eligibility.\n8. Existing historical commit selection and ordering remaining unchanged.\n9. Error reporting for invalid worktrees and diff-generation failures.\n\r\n",

It is available only when the card has a valid assigned worktree with outgoing changes. If integration is unavailable, viewing the worktree diff is also unavailable.\n\nSelecting **View diff** shows the net changes the assigned card worktree would bring into the project branch. The diff covers the complete worktree change set, not only the card Markdown file or one agent commit. Use the card's existing diff-viewing experience, including the card body diff and navigation to other changed files.\n\nThe card popup's existing diff selector must also contain this worktree diff:\n\n- Show it as the first entry, above the historical commit diffs.\n- Label it clearly as the current worktree changes; do not present it as a commit.\n- Selecting it opens the same worktree diff as **View diff** in the worktree menu.\n- Keep the existing historical commit ordering and behavior unchanged.\n- Remove the entry as soon as **Integrate into project** is no longer available, including after successful integration.\n\nThe worktree diff is current repository state. Add a separate read-only worktree-diff operation rather than putting placeholder commit data into `CardCommit` or `ActivityCommitReference`.\n\nResolve the worktree through `WorktreeService` from the card's assigned worktree. The backend remains responsible for Git access and returns normalized per-file diff data to the renderer. Reading the diff must not commit, stage, rebase, merge, or otherwise change either worktree.\n\nModel the card popup selection as either a current worktree diff or a historical commit diff. Both entry points must use the same worktree-diff loading and presentation path. Worktree diff generation across the project branch and assigned worktree.\n2. Added, modified, deleted, and renamed files in the returned diff.\n3. No Git mutation while reading a worktree diff.\n4. Matching availability of **View diff** and **Integrate into project**.\n5. The current worktree entry appearing first in the card popup diff selector.\n6. Both entry points selecting the same worktree diff.\n7. Removal of the entry after integration or loss of worktree eligibility.\n8. Existing historical commit selection and ordering remaining unchanged.\n9. Error reporting for invalid worktrees and diff-generation failures.\n\r\n",

This guide does **not** define colors â€” it tells you **which theme value to use for which role**, and covers the things the theme can't encode: layout, spacing/margins, borders, elevation, and component conventions.\n\n**The one rule that matters:** never write a raw hex, px radius, or magic color into a component. Read it from the theme (`theme.palette.*`, `theme.shape`, `theme.typography`, `theme.spacing`). If a component has a hardcoded hex in its `sx`/styled, it's wrong â€” that's exactly where the look drifts and where dark mode breaks.\n\n---\n\n## 1. How to consume the theme\n\n- **Colors:** `sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', bgcolor: 'background.paper', borderColor: 'divider' }}` â€” MUI resolves dotted palette paths automatically in `sx`. In `styled`/JS use the callback form: `styled(Box)(({ theme }) => ({ color: theme.palette.text.secondary }))`.\n- **Spacing:** use the 8px unit via the spacing scale â€” `sx={{ p: 2, gap: 1, mt: 1.5 }}` (`2` = 16px, `1` = 8px). Don't write `padding: '16px'`.\n- **Radius:** `borderRadius: 1` (= `theme.shape.borderRadius` = 8) and multiples; for the fixed non-8 radii see Â§4.\n- **Typography:** prefer `Typography variant=...` and `theme.typography.*` over ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n- **Custom tokens:** roles the default MUI palette doesn't cover (column/track surfaces, the strong/hover border steps, `text-3/4`, section-header color, `primary-bg` tint, status colors) must exist in the theme under a namespace (e.g. `theme.palette.custom.*`) with light + dark values. Consume them the same way â€” `bgcolor: 'custom.column'`. **Never inline their hex.** If a needed token doesn't exist yet, add it to the theme, don't hardcode it in the component.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Role â†’ theme slot\n\nPick the slot by the element's **role**, not by how it looks in one mode:\n\n| Role | Theme slot |\n|---|---|\n| App background; tinted footer/action bars | `background.default` |\n| Column & sidebar surface | `custom.column` |\n| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |\n| Card, dialog, popup, input surface | `background.paper` |\n| Hairlines, resting borders | `divider` |\n| Input borders, vertical separators | `custom.borderStrong` |\n| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |\n| Titles, values, headings | `text.primary` |\n| Body copy, field labels | `text.secondary` |\n| Meta, captions, resting icons | `custom.text3` |\n| Muted / placeholder / disabled | `custom.text4` |\n| Uppercase section/column headers | `custom.colHead` |\n| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |\n| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |\n| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |\n| Text/icon on a primary fill | `primary.contrastText` |\n| Active / saved / online dot | `success.main` |\n| Destructive action | `error.main` |\n| Status swatch dots & ID-chip tints (decorative only) | `custom.status.*` |\n\nRules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) â€” everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Layout\n\n- **Full-height app:** column flex â€” menu row / ribbon / content (`flex: 1; minHeight: 0`) / status bar. Fixed bands `flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Board:** horizontal-scroll flex row, `gap: 2` (16px), page padding `p: 2.5` (20px); columns `width: 296, flexShrink: 0`, internal column flex `gap: 1`.\n- **List view:** two-pane flex row filling the space between ribbon and status bar â€” sidebar `width: 280, flexShrink: 0`, editor pane `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` (the `minWidth: 0` is required so long content ellipsizes instead of blowing out the row).\n- **Panels (sidebar, editor card, dialogs):** column flex with stacked bands (header / [toolbar] / body / footer). The **body scrolls** (`overflow-y: auto; minHeight: 0`); header and footer are `flexShrink: 0` and never scroll away.\n- **Spacer pattern:** push trailing items with `<Box sx={{ flex: 1 }} />` rather than `margin-left: auto` sprinkled around, so rows stay predictable.\n- Use flex `gap` for spacing between siblings â€” don't hand-space with per-child margins.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Spacing, margin & size conventions\n\n- **4/8px grid, via `theme.spacing`.** page padding `2.5`; between columns `2`; inside columns / between related controls `1`; dialog body gap `2â€“2.25`; field labelâ†’control gap `~0.9` (7px).\n- **Margins:** prefer padding on containers + flex `gap` over element margins. Where a floating panel needs breathing room (e.g. editor card, toolbar inside a panel), use container padding (`p: 2 / 2.5`), not margins on the children.\n- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26â€“28, input 42.\n- **Fixed widths (px):** column 296, sidebar 280, search 260, standard dialog 480, wide/editor dialog 760.\n- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6â€“7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Borders & elevation\n\n- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).\n- **Separation between bands:** a single 1px `divider` hairline. Don't stack a heavy rule *and* an outline â€” one line, let background contrast do the rest. Vertical separators inside toolbars: a 20px-tall `custom.borderStrong` rule.\n- **Elevation ladder (only where floating):** card hover `0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)`; dragging MUI `elevation 8` + `rotate(2deg)`; contained button `0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.15)`; dialog/popup `0 24px 60px rgba(16,24,40,0.28)`; scrim `rgba(16,24,40,0.45)` + `backdropFilter: blur(2px)`.\n- Set `MuiPaper.elevation: 0` and `MuiButton.disableElevation` globally in the theme; add the shadows above explicitly where the ladder calls for it.\n- **On dark backgrounds shadows read as nothing** â€” the theme already handles this by making hover raise `borderColor` (`custom.borderHover`) instead of relying on shadow.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Typography usage\n\nDrive everything from theme variants / `theme.typography`; avoid ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n\n- Titles/values/headings â†’ `text.primary`; body & labels â†’ `text.secondary`; meta â†’ `custom.text3`.\n- **Field labels:** a plain `Typography` (12px/600, `text.secondary`) placed **above** the control â€” **never** MUI floating/outlined `TextField` labels (they clash with the app's flat-label style).\n- **Section/column headers:** `Typography variant=\"overline\"` (uppercase, `letterSpacing ~0.7px`, `fontWeight 700`, `custom.colHead`).\n- **ID chips only** use monospace; everything else is the theme's default family.\n- `button.textTransform: 'none'` and `button.fontWeight: 600` are set in the theme â€” don't re-uppercase buttons.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Interaction states\n\nConsistent across all components; all colors from the theme:\n\n- **Ghost icon button** (`IconButton`): transparent â†’ hover `bgcolor: track` (or `background.paper` on a colored panel) + `color: primary.main`. Override MUI's default circular hover tint via `sx`.\n- **Outlined button:** `divider` border, `text.secondary` â†’ hover `borderColor/color: primary.main`. Destructive: hover `borderColor: error.main` + `bgcolor: custom.dangerBg`.\n- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow â†’ hover `primary.dark`.\n- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.\n- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.\n- **Row-level actions** (delete, â‹®): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).\n- **Active tab/menu item:** 2px `primary.main` bottom border + `primary.main` text.\n- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Component conventions (MUI primitives)\n\n- **Buttons:** `Button variant=\"contained\"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant=\"outlined\"` = secondary; `variant=\"text\"` = tertiary. Icon-only â†’ `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).\n- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13â€“15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.\n- **ID chip:** monospace, accent text on `custom.primaryBg`/status tint, `radius 5, flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Count chip:** `background.paper` bg, 1px `divider`, radius 9â€“10, `custom.text3`.\n- **State dot:** 7â€“8px circle + `text-3` label; green (`success.main`) = active/saved/online.\n- **Search:** pill `TextField` (`borderRadius: 99`, `bgcolor: background.default`), search start-adornment, `âŒ˜K` keycap end-adornment.\n- **Select:** `size=\"small\"`, optional dot+name via `renderValue`; 42px / radius-9 frame. When a select has a tooltip, keep the tooltip available while the select is closed and explicitly hide it for the entire time the select menu is open so it cannot cover the first option.\n- **Segmented control** (view switch, formatting toolbar): `ToggleButtonGroup` on a `custom.track` background; selected segment `background.paper` + `0 1px 2px` shadow + `primary` text.\n- **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` â†’ `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`âŒ˜/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop.\n- **Empty state:** dashed target â€” `1.5px dashed custom.borderStrong`, radius 10, centered icon + `custom.text4` label. No \"click to add\" placeholder blocks.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Definition of done for a new component\n\n1. Zero hardcoded hex / raw px colors â€” every value comes from `theme.palette` / `theme.shape` / `theme.spacing` / `theme.typography`.\n2. Correct roleâ†’slot mapping (Â§2); at most one `primary` CTA on the surface.\n3. Borders at rest, shadow only when floating (Â§5); bands split by a single hairline.\n4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (Â§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.\n5. Body scrolls, header/footer pinned; `minWidth: 0` on flex children that hold long text.\n6. Toggle to dark mode and confirm nothing breaks â€” if it does, you hardcoded a color somewhere (Â§1).\n\nComponent-specific detail lives in `GUIDANCE.md` (theme definition + board/list/dialog), `CARD_POPUP_GUIDE.md`, `RUN_DIALOG_GUIDE.md`, and `SIDEBAR_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md`.\n\r\n",

Role â†’ theme slot\n\nPick the slot by the element's **role**, not by how it looks in one mode:\n\n| Role | Theme slot |\n|---|---|\n| App background; tinted footer/action bars | `background.default` |\n| Column & sidebar surface | `custom.column` |\n| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |\n| Card, dialog, popup, input surface | `background.paper` |\n| Hairlines, resting borders | `divider` |\n| Input borders, vertical separators | `custom.borderStrong` |\n| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |\n| Titles, values, headings | `text.primary` |\n| Body copy, field labels | `text.secondary` |\n| Meta, captions, resting icons | `custom.text3` |\n| Muted / placeholder / disabled | `custom.text4` |\n| Uppercase section/column headers | `custom.colHead` |\n| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |\n| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |\n| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |\n| Text/icon on a primary fill | `primary.contrastText` |\n| Active / saved / online dot | `success.main` |\n| Destructive action | `error.main` |\n| Status swatch dots & ID-chip tints (decorative only) | `custom.status.*` |\n\nRules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) â€” everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Layout\n\n- **Full-height app:** column flex â€” menu row / ribbon / content (`flex: 1; minHeight: 0`) / status bar. Fixed bands `flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Board:** horizontal-scroll flex row, `gap: 2` (16px), page padding `p: 2.5` (20px); columns `width: 296, flexShrink: 0`, internal column flex `gap: 1`.\n- **List view:** two-pane flex row filling the space between ribbon and status bar â€” sidebar `width: 280, flexShrink: 0`, editor pane `flex: 1, minWidth: 0` (the `minWidth: 0` is required so long content ellipsizes instead of blowing out the row).\n- **Panels (sidebar, editor card, dialogs):** column flex with stacked bands (header / [toolbar] / body / footer). The **body scrolls** (`overflow-y: auto; minHeight: 0`); header and footer are `flexShrink: 0` and never scroll away.\n- **Spacer pattern:** push trailing items with `<Box sx={{ flex: 1 }} />` rather than `margin-left: auto` sprinkled around, so rows stay predictable.\n- Use flex `gap` for spacing between siblings â€” don't hand-space with per-child margins.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Spacing, margin & size conventions\n\n- **4/8px grid, via `theme.spacing`.** page padding `2.5`; between columns `2`; inside columns / between related controls `1`; dialog body gap `2â€“2.25`; field labelâ†’control gap `~0.9` (7px).\n- **Margins:** prefer padding on containers + flex `gap` over element margins. Where a floating panel needs breathing room (e.g. editor card, toolbar inside a panel), use container padding (`p: 2 / 2.5`), not margins on the children.\n- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26â€“28, input 42.\n- **Fixed widths (px):** column 296, sidebar 280, search 260, standard dialog 480, wide/editor dialog 760.\n- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6â€“7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Borders & elevation\n\n- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).\n- **Separation between bands:** a single 1px `divider` hairline. Don't stack a heavy rule *and* an outline â€” one line, let background contrast do the rest. Vertical separators inside toolbars: a 20px-tall `custom.borderStrong` rule.\n- **Elevation ladder (only where floating):** card hover `0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)`; dragging MUI `elevation 8` + `rotate(2deg)`; contained button `0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.15)`; dialog/popup `0 24px 60px rgba(16,24,40,0.28)`; scrim `rgba(16,24,40,0.45)` + `backdropFilter: blur(2px)`.\n- Set `MuiPaper.elevation: 0` and `MuiButton.disableElevation` globally in the theme; add the shadows above explicitly where the ladder calls for it.\n- **On dark backgrounds shadows read as nothing** â€” the theme already handles this by making hover raise `borderColor` (`custom.borderHover`) instead of relying on shadow.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Typography usage\n\nDrive everything from theme variants / `theme.typography`; avoid ad-hoc `fontSize`.\n\n- Titles/values/headings â†’ `text.primary`; body & labels â†’ `text.secondary`; meta â†’ `custom.text3`.\n- **Field labels:** a plain `Typography` (12px/600, `text.secondary`) placed **above** the control â€” **never** MUI floating/outlined `TextField` labels (they clash with the app's flat-label style).\n- **Section/column headers:** `Typography variant=\"overline\"` (uppercase, `letterSpacing ~0.7px`, `fontWeight 700`, `custom.colHead`).\n- **ID chips only** use monospace; everything else is the theme's default family.\n- `button.textTransform: 'none'` and `button.fontWeight: 600` are set in the theme â€” don't re-uppercase buttons.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Interaction states\n\nConsistent across all components; all colors from the theme:\n\n- **Ghost icon button** (`IconButton`): transparent â†’ hover `bgcolor: track` (or `background.paper` on a colored panel) + `color: primary.main`. Override MUI's default circular hover tint via `sx`.\n- **Outlined button:** `divider` border, `text.secondary` â†’ hover `borderColor/color: primary.main`. Destructive: hover `borderColor: error.main` + `bgcolor: custom.dangerBg`.\n- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow â†’ hover `primary.dark`.\n- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.\n- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.\n- **Row-level actions** (delete, â‹®): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).\n- **Active tab/menu item:** 2px `primary.main` bottom border + `primary.main` text.\n- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Component conventions (MUI primitives)\n\n- **Buttons:** `Button variant=\"contained\"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant=\"outlined\"` = secondary; `variant=\"text\"` = tertiary. Icon-only â†’ `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).\n- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13â€“15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.\n- **ID chip:** monospace, accent text on `custom.primaryBg`/status tint, `radius 5, flexShrink: 0`.\n- **Count chip:** `background.paper` bg, 1px `divider`, radius 9â€“10, `custom.text3`.\n- **State dot:** 7â€“8px circle + `text-3` label; green (`success.main`) = active/saved/online.\n- **Search:** pill `TextField` (`borderRadius: 99`, `bgcolor: background.default`), search start-adornment, `âŒ˜K` keycap end-adornment.\n- **Select:** `size=\"small\"`, optional dot+name via `renderValue`; 42px / radius-9 frame. When a select has a tooltip, keep the tooltip available while the select is closed and explicitly hide it for the entire time the select menu is open so it cannot cover the first option.\n- **Segmented control** (view switch, formatting toolbar): `ToggleButtonGroup` on a `custom.track` background; selected segment `background.paper` + `0 1px 2px` shadow + `primary` text.\n- **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` â†’ `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`âŒ˜/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop.\n- **Empty state:** dashed target â€” `1.5px dashed custom.borderStrong`, radius 10, centered icon + `custom.text4` label. No \"click to add\" placeholder blocks.\n\n---\n\n## 9. Definition of done for a new component\n\n1. Zero hardcoded hex / raw px colors â€” every value comes from `theme.palette` / `theme.shape` / `theme.spacing` / `theme.typography`.\n2. Correct roleâ†’slot mapping (Â§2); at most one `primary` CTA on the surface.\n3. Borders at rest, shadow only when floating (Â§5); bands split by a single hairline.\n4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (Â§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.\n5. Body scrolls, header/footer pinned; `minWidth: 0` on flex children that hold long text.\n6. Toggle to dark mode and confirm nothing breaks â€” if it does, you hardcoded a color somewhere (Â§1).\n\nComponent-specific detail lives in `GUIDANCE.md` (theme definition + board/list/dialog), `CARD_POPUP_GUIDE.md`, `RUN_DIALOG_GUIDE.md`, and `SIDEBAR_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md`.\n\r\n",

The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÂ² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÂ² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÂ² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÂ² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÂ² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - Failed and declined reasoning already use the error presentation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Filter conversation feed activities in `ActionConversationChat`: omit only events where `type === 'reasoning'` and `status === 'completed'`.\\r\\n- Keep in-progress, failed, declined and unknown-status reasoning visible.\\r\\n- Keep completed reasoning events in conversation data and persisted history; this is a presentation-only change.\\r\\n- Update chat tests for live completion, reopened conversations, failed/declined reasoning and unaffected non-reasoning activities.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- In-progress reasoning is visible.\\r\\n- A reasoning block disappears when its status becomes `completed`, including after reopening a conversation.\\r\\n- Failed and declined reasoning remains visible with its error state and content.\\r\\n- Completed non-reasoning activities remain visible.\\r\\n\\n===== F_94_no_prefill_prompt_running_conv.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_94\\r\\ninternalId: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\ntitle: no prefill prompt running conv\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nWhen an agent is waiting for a response, but the action popup was closed or on the wrong 'action', then when the user clicks on the action to view the conversation and answer, the input box is prefilled again with the action's prompt. this is annoying cause it needs to be removed.\\r\\n\\r\\nso, when activating an action that has a running conversation, don't prefill the input\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`useActionPopupController` prepares an action's stored prompt for a new conversation. When popup opens on another action, or reopens while execution state is being restored, that prepared prompt can remain in `promptState` when user selects action with a `queued`, `running`, or `waitingForInput` conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Give active execution its own prompt identity, including before active-child metadata arrives.\\r\\n- When active action is selected, seed editor only from its shared user-entered draft; otherwise show empty input.\\r\\n- Invalidate pending prompt preparation and bump `promptResetToken` when action becomes active.\\r\\n- Keep stored-prompt prefill for idle actions starting new conversations. Keep command actions unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\\r\\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\\r\\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\\r\\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\\r\\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\\r\\n\\n===== F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_95\\r\\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\\r\\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. The backend checkpoints primary-worktree changes, rebases the card branch when behind, then fast-forwards the project branch. The operation returns no commit metadata.\\r\\n\\r\\nCard commit history reads tracked `<projectFolder>/activity/card__<cardInternalId>.json` files. Only action executions add commit references, so commits integrated from the selector are absent unless an action already recorded them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add a card-specific integration request containing `cardInternalId` and `projectFolder`; project-level worktree integration remains untracked.\\r\\n- After any rebase, squash the card branch's complete change onto the project branch and create one integration commit.
